How the checks work

How the score works

Lumi pays x402 sellers a few cents for real, records what came back, and keeps a signed receipt for every buy.

  1. 1Lumi checks the quoteA free request asks each endpoint for its x402 price quote and checks it is readable and payable.
  2. 2Lumi makes a small paid test-buyLumi pays a few cents from its own wallet and records whether real data came back.
  3. 3The payment is on a public ledgerEvery paid test-buy is a real transaction on XRPL, Base or Stellar, kept with a signed receipt. The tx hash of each seller's latest buy is free on the trust list; the signed receipts come with the paid vendor report.

Vendor trust list

Open the list →

Check an x402 seller before your agent pays it. Lumi makes real on-ledger test-buys from x402 sellers on the XRP Ledger, Base and Stellar, and keeps a signed receipt for each one. The pay check, GET /v1/trust/check?url=, answers allow, warn or block with reasons for any x402 URL, for $0.02 per check. The full report on one vendor from the list, with tx hashes and signed receipts, is $0.02. The vendor trust list is free. Paying Lumi never changes a score.

As of Oct 28, 2026, the trust list covers 101,033 x402 listings across 4,460 seller domains, with 1,960 paid test-buys on record. In a one-off sweep completed Oct 23, 2026, Lumi checked all 98 third-party hosts that list an XRPL payment option in Coinbase's x402 Bazaar and bought from 93: 82 delivered data, 2 did not, and 9 were inconclusive because of errors on Lumi's side (not counted against the sellers). Every payment is an XRPL mainnet transaction.
